title: Adaptive spot scarcity mediator + GPU selection curator
creator: Ava Chen
description: Goal: implement an adaptive mediation layer that converts real-time spot scarcity signals and tenant budget telemetry into safe, predictable routing decisions and GPU substitutions. The mediator (1) evaluates per-tenant soft/hard budget caps and remaining headroom, (2) ingests spot eviction likelihood and regional scarcity indicators, (3) selects an acceptable GPU family or model-variant fallback (quantized/lightweight variant) per request, and (4) emits routing hints and rate-limit adjustments to the allocator. Success criteria: maintain tenant SLAs (p90 latency, availability) while keeping spend under configured caps for 95% of tenants during simulated spot crunches; produce clear audit logs and per-request routing reasons visible in Console routes dashboard. This ticket covers design, runtime policy implementation, conservative rollout (canary), and runbook for rollback/mitigation.
acceptance_criteria: Policy reacts to synthetic spot-scarcity signal within 10s and routes to fallback variant when budget headroom < configured soft cap
Per-tenant spend never exceeds hard cap for 100% of simulated tests over 24h window
Fallback model variants maintain minimum quality thresholds (BLEU/ROUGE/embedding-similarity) per PM test set
Console shows per-request routing reason and cost delta; tracing links to allocator decisions
Canary rollout completed for 10% of tenants without SLO regressions before full rollout
risks_and_tradeoffs: Trade-offs: aggressive fallback decisions reduce spend but may degrade quality for latency-sensitive tenants; conservative thresholds preserve quality but risk budget overshoot during prolonged preemptible shortages. We must balance detection latency (false positives from noisy spot signals) vs. stability. Implementation choices: centralized mediator (single decision service) vs. distributed per-region agents; choose hybrid: central policy with local caches to avoid added RTT. We will start with conservative thresholds and provide tenant opt-in for aggressive savings.
implementation_plan: Week 1: finalize policy DSL and metrics (headroom, soft_cap_pct, hard_cap_pct, eviction_score) and wire scarcity signal feed
Week 2: implement mediator service + policy engine + local region cache; unit tests + integration harness
Week 3: integrate with allocator to accept routing hints and model-variant preferences; add per-request audit metadata
Week 4: run synthetic chaos tests (evict spot nodes), measure budget enforcement and quality delta; adjust thresholds
Week 5: canary rollout (10% tenants) + monitoring alerting; gather feedback and iterate; prepare runbook
Week 6: full rollout and handover to SRE + docs
